definitions.reprojection: px error of the 5 racket model points (tip, throat, butt, side A, side B) against RacketVision keypoints on frames/points with weight>0; filled frames excluded. PCK threshold 0.2 x racket length (0.686 m) projected at FlowHMR wrist depth (assumed scale).
definitions.tilt_deg: asin of the vertical component of the face normal, normal signed toward court-forward (same definition as the solver audit); >0 open, <0 closed; angle_to_ground = 90-|tilt| (Kwon 2017 ~80 deg).
definitions.head_speed: string-bed centre (0.001,0.432,0 racket-local) speed by central difference at the data rate; 30 fps under-samples the peak.
definitions.wrist angles: from the SMPL-X body joints (forearm elbow->wrist vs middle metacarpal), identical for all fits because fits only change the racket relative to the same body; the A/B racket is rigidly attached to this wrist bone.
definitions.grip_lock: relative rotation between the racket and an independent hand estimate (FlowHMR wrist bone; WiLoR hand on observed frames): median angular deviation from the mean relative pose. Zero by construction for the fit driven by that estimate.
definitions.frame_step/flips/jerk: frame-to-frame racket rotation >60 deg and face-normal sign flips counted outside +-5 frames of contact; linear jerk RMS of the string-bed centre.
